title: Document Management — Upload a Document
purpose: Upload a compliance document, link it to products, suppliers or factories, set its dates and reminders, and add compliance data.
meta: Save To → Dates & Reminder → Compliance Data → Confirm
overview: Open **Document Management** and click **Upload**, then choose one or more files from your computer.
**Save To**: link the document to suppliers, factories or products.
**Dates & Reminder**: set issue, expiry and review dates and an email reminder.
**Compliance Data**: add test data, certificate data or other data. Click **Confirm**.

body: In the left menu, open **Document Management**. The tabs show **All**, **Pending Review**, **Expired**, **Archived** and **Trash** documents. Click **Upload** at the top right and choose your file.

body.caption: Document Management list with the Upload button.
body.alt: Document Management list on the All tab with Upload, filters and the test report HK2611-05112_Food_Jar_Test_Report.pdf at the top.

body: The **Upload Document** pop-up shows the file name. Click the pencil icon to rename it. Under **Type**, type or select a document type, for example **Test Report**.

body.caption: Upload Document pop-up.
body.alt: Upload Document pop-up for HK2611-05112_Food_Jar_Test_Report.pdf with Type Test Report and the Save To, Dates & Reminder and Compliance Data tabs.

body: On the **Save To** tab, click **Add Supplier**, **Add Factory** or **Add Product**. Select the items in the pop-up and click **Confirm**. A document can be linked to several items. Click **Remove** to unlink one.

body.caption: The document linked to a product.
body.alt: Save To tab with Add Supplier, Add Factory, Add Product and the linked product Kids Insulated Food Jar 400 ml with Remove.

body: Set the **Issue Date**, **Expiry Date** and **Review Date**. Under **Email Reminder**, choose **On Expiry Date**, **On Review Date** or **Custom** to get an email reminder. Add a **Note** to include in the reminder email. Use **Clear All Settings** to start again.

body.caption: Dates & Reminder tab.
body.alt: Dates & Reminder tab with issue date 18 Nov 26, expiry date 17 Nov 27, review date 17 Oct 27 and the On Expiry Date email reminder.

body: Click **Edit** next to **Test Data**, **Certificate Data** or **Other** to record the details from the document, such as test items and results or certificate numbers.

body.caption: Compliance Data tab.
body.alt: Compliance Data tab with Test Data, Certificate Data and Other, each with Edit.

body: Click **Confirm**. QMAS shows a success message and the document appears at the top of the list, with its type and the number of linked products, suppliers and factories.

body.caption: The uploaded document at the top of the list.
body.alt: The uploaded test report at the top of the list with type Test Report, review and expiry dates and 1 linked product.

tips: Set an expiry date and reminder for certificates and test reports so you know before they expire.
You can also upload documents from a product, supplier or factory profile.
faq: How do I upload a document?
Go to Document Management (https://qmas.icw.io/document-management), click Upload, choose the file, set the Type, link it under Save To, then click Confirm.
How do I get a reminder before a document expires?
In the Upload Document pop-up, open Dates & Reminder, set the Expiry Date, then choose an Email Reminder option.
Where can I see expired documents?
Open the Expired tab in Document Management.
